It uses multiple AI agents to search existing knowledge sources, test existing docs for validity and style guidelines, and clicks, scrolls, and uses enterprise software through a web browser to generate docs with embedded screenshots and video recordings. Quanstruct is available as a cloud service to start, targeting technical writers, content writing, professional services, and product teams.

<h2 id="problem"><strong>Problem</strong></h2>
<p>The best product & customer teams stomach some difficult truths to serve their customers today:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Product & customer education demands active effort</strong> from product and engineering experts with limited time</li>
<li><strong>Teams need to understand too much</strong> source code, support, communication threads & product specs to properly guide customers</li>
<li><strong>High-quality docs require 100% validation</strong> to test code snippets, external links, accessibility guidelines, take screenshots, and other references. Traditional Gen AI falls short.</li>
<li><strong>Helping customers supersedes keeping docs up to date</strong></li>
</ol>
<p>The result? <strong>Documentation debt</strong> - where your product and technical docs & implementation plans go increasingly out of sync.</p>
<p>We felt this pain thousands of times previously, when we helped Fortune 500 customers integrate with 100s of enterprise software platforms that were poorly documented. We saw how <strong>documentation debt</strong> could escalate customer support issues and lead to customers not adopting and championing the platform.</p>
<p>We also saw how paying down documentation debt could amplify each team’s impact, inspire customer love, and help nurture a community of strongly activated champions.</p>
<h2 id="solution"><strong>Solution</strong></h2>
<p>Quantstruct connects to your docs platform, GitHub, and Slack to continuously update your docs</p>
<ol>
<li>When a <strong>PR</strong> occurs, Quantstruct works behind the scenes and notifies you about a companion docs update</li>
<li>Each type of doc update can be configured with tools and agents to
<ul>
<li><em>Check WCAG accessibility guidelines</em></li>
<li><em>Check broken links</em></li>
<li><em>Take screenshots and videos</em></li>
<li><em>Generate system architecture diagrams</em></li>
<li><em>Validate code blocks</em></li>
<li><em>and much, much more.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>You can manually edit the doc or provide high-level instructions, and Quantstruct updates and publishes the necessary sections without work</li>
<li>Quantstruct’s platform will take care of the hard bits of coordinating multiple agents, self-evaluating and improving performance, following your specific review & publishing workflows</li>
</ol>

<p>Sign up for <a href="https://quantstruct.com">Quantstruct</a>, and install our GitHub and Slack apps to get started! You can also reach out to <a href="mailto:founders@quantstruct.com">founders@quantstruct.com</a> to guide you through the onboarding process.</p>

<p>Both are published researchers and patent holders from <strong>Georgia Tech CS</strong> and <strong>Berkeley EECS,</strong> respectively.</p>
<p>We’ve spent our careers building for developers at enterprise software companies and deeply empathize with the pressures that support, customer success, product, and GTM teams face to build world-class developer products and ecosystems.</p>
